title: [VSC-28] VS Code docs sweep for the follow-up wave (VSC-23, VSC-25, VSC-27)
description:
Filed by architect-d54b05fd while planning VSC-23 (task-921ca494). None of the code plans for VSC-23, VSC-25 or VSC-27 edits docs. VSC-24's plan carries its own CHANGELOG and MANUAL_TESTS entries, and VSC-26 is JetBrains-only.

Objective: once the follow-up rows land, moe-vscode's docs must stop describing the limits those rows fixed. VSC-18 (DONE, 78642f85) wrote these lines on purpose, as the open follow-ups:
- moe-vscode/README.md "Known issues", three lines:
  - "The task detail panel's Delivery section and Release Agent button show the task as it was when the panel opened; reopen the panel to refresh them" (VSC-23);
  - "While disconnected, the Claude accounts view lists no accounts, so a CLI-only sign-in is not offered (the JetBrains Accounts tab still offers it)" (VSC-25);
  - "On Windows, agent and account terminals expect PowerShell as the default terminal profile" (VSC-27).
- moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md "Task detail: Delivery and Release Agent" step 6: "Known limit (row VSC-23): ...".
- moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] has no entries for VSC-23, VSC-25 or VSC-27.
- docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md "Follow-ups filed during the epic" lists VSC-23 to VSC-27 with their status when written (PLANNING).

Deliverable:
- Each README line is removed, or rewritten to the narrower limit the row actually shipped. Read each row's completion diff first; never assume.
- MANUAL_TESTS.md step 6 becomes a live-refresh check (with the panel open, a change to the task's delivery evidence or assigned agent shows without reopening). Add a manual step for VSC-25's disconnected accounts rows and CLI sign-in, and one for VSC-27's non-PowerShell default terminal profile.
- One CHANGELOG [Unreleased] bullet each for VSC-23, VSC-25 and VSC-27. Keep VSC-24's entry as it landed.
- The reuse doc's follow-up table shows each of VSC-23 to VSC-27 with its final status and its landing commit.

NOT in scope: any code or test file, JetBrains docs, the epic rails' avoid list (CLAUDE.md, docs/roles/**, docs/MCP_SERVER.md, docs/SCHEMA.md and the rest), and re-designating the epic's final task.

Promote this row to PLANNING only after its dependsOn rows are DONE: its plan has to read what each of them shipped.

Verification command (run from the repo root):
! grep -nE "show the task as it was when the panel opened|lists no accounts, so a CLI-only sign-in is not offered|expect PowerShell as the default terminal profile" moe-vscode/README.md && ! grep -n "Known limit (row VSC-23)" moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md
If a row only narrowed its limit, replace the first grep's pattern for that line with one for the rewritten text, and quote both in the completion summary.
definitionOfDone: moe-vscode/README.md Known issues no longer carries the VSC-23, VSC-25 or VSC-27 sentence quoted in the description. Each one is removed, or rewritten to the narrower limit that row's completion diff shows, and the completion summary names which and why.

moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md no longer contains "Known limit (row VSC-23)". The Delivery and Release Agent section gains a numbered live-refresh step, and there is one numbered manual step each for VSC-25 (disconnected accounts rows, CLI sign-in) and VSC-27 (a non-PowerShell default terminal profile on Windows).
moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] has one bullet each describing the user-visible fix of VSC-23, VSC-25 and VSC-27, and VSC-24's own entry is unchanged.

The "Follow-ups filed during the epic" table in docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md shows VSC-23 to VSC-27 with their final status and a landing commit sha. `git log --grep 'Moe-Task: <id>'` finds each sha.

The completion commit changes only moe-vscode/README.md, moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md, moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md and docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md (check with git show --stat), and the description's verification command exits 0.
taskRails: Docs only. Edit nothing outside moe-vscode/README.md, moe-vscode/MANUAL_TESTS.md, moe-vscode/CHANGELOG.md and docs/plans/2026-11-02-vscode-reuse.md, and use the Edit tool only.
